title: Second Highest Salary
schemaData: CREATE TABLE Employee (id INT, salary INT); INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,100),(2,200);
correctQuery: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);

title: Employees By Department
description:
# Problem
Find employees grouped by department.
schemaData: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INT, dept TEXT);
correctQuery: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM Employee GROUP BY dept;
